description: This PHP source file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) class 'ProjectActivityDao' for managing project activities within the 'OrangeHRM' human resource management system. It provides methods for retrieving, saving, updating, and deleting project activity records, as well as for performing various queries related to project activities, such as counting, duplication checks, and copying activities between projects.

classes.name: ProjectActivityDao
classes.description: A DAO class for accessing and manipulating project activity data within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getProjectActivityListByProjectId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of project activities associated with a specific project, filtered by provided search parameters.

methods.name: getProjectActivitiesPaginator
methods.description: Constructs and returns a paginator object for paginating project activity data based on filtering criteria.

methods.name: getProjectActivityCount
methods.description: Returns the count of project activities matching the filter criteria within a specific project.

methods.name: saveProjectActivity
methods.description: Persists a ProjectActivity entity to the database.

methods.name: getProjectById
methods.description: Retrieves a Project entity by its ID.

methods.name: getProjectActivityByProjectIdAndProjectActivityId
methods.description: Fetches a specific ProjectActivity given project and activity IDs.

methods.name: getExistingProjectActivityIdsForProject
methods.description: Checks which activity IDs already exist for a given project, excluding deleted activities.

methods.name: hasActivityGotTimesheetItems
methods.description: Determines if a project activity has associated timesheet items.

methods.name: deleteProjectActivities
methods.description: Marks specified project activities as deleted, after ensuring they have no associated timesheet entries.

methods.name: isProjectActivityNameTaken
methods.description: Checks if a project activity name is already taken within a project, optionally excluding a specific activity ID.

methods.name: getDuplicatedActivities
methods.description: Finds duplicate activities between two projects based on activity names.

methods.name: getProjectActivitiesByActivityIds
methods.description: Retrieves all ProjectActivity entities based on a list of activity IDs.

methods.name: copyActivities
methods.description: Copies activities from one project to another.

methods.name: getActivitiesCountByProjectActivityIdPairs
methods.description: Returns the count of activities matching a list of project ID and activity ID pairs.

methods.name: getActivitiesPaginatorByProjectActivityIdPairs
methods.description: Constructs a paginator object for activities based on pairs of project and activity IDs.
